download_vanilla_1024_model: download the vanilla_1024 LIGHT whoami model to the specified datapath directory
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the vanilla_1024 model with version v1.0
test_download: test the download function by calling it with a target datapath argument
review_download_function: review the download function that delegates to download_with_model_type for model retrieval
summarize_download: summarize the download function which fetches the vanilla_1024 BB3B fine-tuned LIGHT model
